r1.head: 80e9b195bbd8aa9b67e0ab88e7832f0de7f8eff2
r1.finding: PublicGrid.front_blocked is strictly bool; features rejects any non-bool, and feature 8 converts it to float. No explicit unobserved state.

c23.head: 80e9b195bbd8aa9b67e0ab88e7832f0de7f8eff2
c23.finding: NativeSelective.choose updates evidence from st.front_blocked before returning decision. ConventionalProbabilistic.choose likewise updates Beta posterior and derives blocked/open state.

c26.head: 4a28b1538042743a84954eb47dbb6ba226ccbb9a
c26.finding: simple_blind maps read-suppressed state to PublicGrid(...,False), not separate missingness. In blinded branch choose occurs before clearing selected original edge memory.

c27.head: 80e9b195bbd8aa9b67e0ab88e7832f0de7f8eff2
c27.finding: Native and conventional blind branches call no_probe_choose(kind,model,sanitized_false) before pop/exclusion. First chosen physical next action cannot be undone after the choice; selection consumes fabricated observed-clear value.

r10.head: 56e0c14393b8a7ddee479dbee6779f092f33267d
r10.finding: Authentic seven-action source public frame/action/after adapter; not direct replacement for R1 three-action public occupancy channel.

information_invariants.collision: UNOBSERVED == OBSERVED_CLEAR under existing C27 encoder; non-injective; information cannot be reconstructed by choosing on encoded Boolean.
information_invariants.proposed_policy_semantics: Withheld inputs MUST not count as negative evidence, must not update sensor-specific memory or posterior, and should be represented with explicit observed/present flag, within permitted typed source-private-free public boundary. Do not invent a hidden cell property.
information_invariants.ablation_order: For source-equal physical A/B, freeze pre-decision checkpoint; compute B using no-newly-revealed-input and no-new-probe-ledger access BEFORE selecting next action. Preserve the other previously earned public evidence. Compare true after and reward traces, verify identical physical first action, source-public frame identity and full-cost attribution.
information_invariants.contrasts: A vs B information-only valid only when actual public observed signal differs from unknown/suppressed state and changes a source-selected policy action; clear and blocked strata must be independently represented. C-route with different heading is physically confounded.
information_invariants.unavailable: The original R1 bool-only feature contract cannot ingest an unknown flag; introducing an unknown presence bit is a separate native-owned interface design, not this FORGE audit.

scientific_limits.original_public_sensor_truth: A truth-bearing bool is always provided to R1 from its FullyObsWrapper processing in the cited source; unknown is a deliberate evaluator ablation, not a naturally missing output emitted by R1.
scientific_limits.semantic_witness: source-free test of representation and call-order invariants, NOT proof actual original model actions diverge on any specific unconsumed source
scientific_limits.followup_requirement: Existing Yggdrasil owner must explicitly approve any prospective separate observed_flag interface and transactional experiment. Its own immutable tests must verify source-authentic read/no-read, no fake clear, no update from missing sensor, cold snapshot parity, independently blinded original action divergence and equal-information conventional peers. Mandatory Linux/Windows source, atlas, final regression and independent first-use remain separate.

decision.next_gate: ACC143 existing owner-approved source-only contract correction eligibility, not a native patch from FORGE; if no owner authorization, close as blocked and redirect FORGE research rather than repeating audit.
